title: primula elatior subsp. poloninensis
intro: Primula elatior subsp. poloninensis, commonly known as the greater primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the primrose family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Primula elatior subsp. poloninensis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
